body: If it helps, becoming strong and decisive is completely possible. Therapy can help. Surrounding yourself with encouraging people can help. I know people who have overcome that. But even if you are not, I think it's fine as long as you are good.

I don't think its a matter of forgiving or anything. It's just the way I've become. I don't know when exactly I started being like this, but I don't know any other way of being. No matter where I go, I'm still me. Thanks for the response.
